description: Cautious: Final Table Round: the last Sell Phase, with a caught Pidgey and Psyduck.

you.personality: Cautious: Plays safe and steady; avoids fights and gambles, and keeps promises to protect a lead.

sell_team_0.instructions: Sell Phase at Start: should `you.team[0]` (Charmander) be sold now? Its facts are in `sell_phase.offers.sell_team_0`. `sale_value_now` (coins from selling it now) and `keep_value` (loss of your best battle-ready Battle stat if it is removed) are separate values, each low, medium or high. Keep value is low for no loss, medium for a small loss and high for a large loss; it does not predict recovery from Tired, evolution or future sale coins. `class_bonus` says whether your class adds bonus coins to this sale; a once-per-Lap bonus goes to only one Pokémon per Sell Phase.

criteria.true: Sell it now: you get its sale value now, plus the class bonus if `class_bonus` says so, and you no longer have the Pokémon. If you sell every Pokémon you have, you get a Rescue Starter, which sells for nothing.
criteria.false: Keep it: you keep the Pokémon and can sell it at a later Sell Phase. When `sell_phase.last_sell_phase` is true there is none: a Pokémon kept to the end of the game is sold automatically for less, with no class bonus.
